scripts.install:all: npm --prefix apps/gateway install && npm --prefix apps/jeenee install && npm --prefix apps/j-son install
scripts.db:migrate: npm --prefix apps/gateway run db:migrate && npm --prefix apps/jeenee run db:migrate && npm --prefix apps/j-son run db:migrate
scripts.dev: concurrently -n gateway,jeenee,j-son -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm --prefix apps/gateway run dev" "npm --prefix apps/jeenee run dev" "npm --prefix apps/j-son run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/gateway run build && npm --prefix apps/jeenee run build && npm --prefix apps/j-son run build
scripts.start: concurrently -n gateway,jeenee,j-son -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm --prefix apps/gateway run start" "npm --prefix apps/jeenee run start -- -p 3001" "npm --prefix apps/j-son run start -- -p 3002"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/gateway run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/jeenee run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/j-son run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix apps/gateway test && npm --prefix apps/jeenee test && npm --prefix apps/j-son test
